name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关，给数据信念下判决书
tagline_zh: 建模前先做诚实审计：分布、重尾、样本量下限，把「看起来相关」测成 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED…
tagline_en: Honest audit: distributions, heavy tails, sample floors. Tests popular beliefs and labels them.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 机制上把 EDA 变成判决流程：每个信念都有明确测试和结果标签，不靠肉眼，不靠感觉。
why_en: Turns EDA into a verdict system: each belief gets a mini-test with a clear label, not eyeballing. Refuses conclusions when.
limit_zh: 只做单变量分布与两变量关系的信号审计，不产出模型、不做多变量因果推断；需要用户提供明确假设或待验证信念。
limit_en: Only audits univariate distributions and bivariate relations; no models, no multivariate causality. Needs explicit hypotheses; otherwise outputs.
title_en: Verdict-style EDA & signal audit before modeling
